[[Fable Reef]] |Time = 6:00 am - 8:00 pm |Season = {{Season|All}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 65 |Behavior = Dart |Size = 20 - 27 in |XP = 24 |Edibility = 13 |base = 250 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught at [[Stardew:Ginger Island|Ginger Island (Ocean)]] or [[Fable Reef]] during any season, in any weather, between 6:00 am to 8:00 pm. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Island West.png|center|400px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Island South.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, west - Fish Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, south - Fish Zones |} {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Island Southeast.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Fable Reef.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, southeast - Fish Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Fable Reef - Fish Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Henchman, Lance, Leo, Linus, Morgan, Pam, Sebastian, Willy |hate= Evelyn, Haley, Martin, Pierre, Scarlett, Sophia }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Barred Knifejaw}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|blue}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a blue color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
